raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 has a second ingest at 05:00 that re-delivers ~338 rows already delivered at 02:00. The re-delivered rows have txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768716261000 = 2026-01-18 06:04:21 UTC, matching the original row). That breaks the TIMESTAMP cast and would also duplicate transactions. The fix parses epoch-ms timestamps as UTC and dedupes by txn_id, keeping the earliest ingest.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, txn_ts) = 1;"}}
